description.value: A municipal outdoor swimming pool in the Hammond neighbourhood of Maple Ridge, operated by the city's Parks & Recreation department. Part of Maple Ridge's network of recreation facilities, it offers a seasonal open-air swim experience convenient for cyclists on the Lougheed Highway corridor or exploring the Fraser Valley.
